query_evaluations.query: Can the Supreme Court exercise powers under Article 142 of the Constitution to grant admission to an IIT candidate from a marginalized community who was prevented from paying fees due to a portal login glitch?

claims.text: The Supreme Court can exercise powers under Article 142 for remedial measures in cases where individuals are unable to perform their legal obligations due to circumstances beyond their control.

In the case of Atul Kumar, despite taking all steps required by IIT's formalities for admission and facing a portal login glitch that prevented timely fee payment, his situation falls under circumstances where Article 142 can be invoked.
